# @three-ws/tutor-mcp

> three.ws Pay-As-You-Learn tutor ledger from any AI agent — read a learning session's itemized running tab and close it for an attested invoice. Free, no key, no signer; answering questions is the paid action handled elsewhere.

@three-ws/tutor-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/tutor-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/ai-tutor-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/ai-tutor-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/ai-tutor-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/ai-tutor-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
